Álvares, a Portuguese and Galician surname, originally a patronymic meaning Son of Álvaro, is the name of:Ana Ida Alvares, Brazilian volleyball player
Chris Alvares (1901–1994), Surinamese classical musician and composer
Francisco Álvares (1465–1541), Portuguese missionary and explorer
João Álvares Fagundes, Portuguese explorer
Jorge Álvares, Portuguese explorer
Mara Alvares, Brazilian artist
Nuno Álvares Pereira (1360–1431), Portuguese general and constable of Portugal
Pedro Álvares Cabral, Portuguese navigator and explorer, discoverer of Brazil
